description: Rear fuselage/tail section only of an unidentified Mirage-family airframe, repainted as Dagger C-410 in memory of 1st Lt Carlos Castillo of Oliva, shot down 24 May 1982; a few blocks from the Museo Nacional Malvinas. Photographed July 2010 and listed in the 2023 Gaceta Aeronáutica census.
museum_name: Terminal de Ómnibus Dagger Tail Monument, Oliva
